whyMatters.en: Austin instrumental post-rock quartet; The Earth Is Not a Cold Dead Place (2003) set US crescendo-guitar grammar beside Mogwai/Godspeed.
whyMatters.zh: 奥斯汀器乐 post-rock 四重奏；The Earth Is Not a Cold Dead Place（2003）在 Mogwai/Godspeed 旁定下美国渐强吉他语法。

shortBio.en: Wordless post-rock band; Your Hand in Mine is the signature long-form build.
shortBio.zh: 无人声 post-rock；Your Hand in Mine 是标志性长结构渐强。

body.en:
Formed 1999 in Austin. Early Temporary Residence releases and the 2003 album fixed delay-heavy interlocking guitars, soft-to-loud arcs, and film/TV licensing reach (Friday Night Lights association).

Your Hand in Mine (2003) is the entry cue. No vocals, no verse-chorus pop—narrative load sits in arrangement dynamics and recorded room.
body.zh:
1999 年于奥斯汀组建。早期 Temporary Residence 发行与 2003 专辑定型：大量延时交织吉他、弱到强弧线，以及影视授权触达（与 Friday Night Lights 关联）。

Your Hand in Mine（2003）是入口。无人声、无主歌副歌流行结构——叙事载荷落在编曲动态与录音空间。
